title: Translates of a test function supported in B_s(0) by centres in the closed ball B̄_R(0) are test functions in B_{2R}(0) with the same integral
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, R, s ∈ ℝ with s < R, φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n with Lebesgue measure) smooth (ContDiff ℝ ⊤) with tsupport φ ⊆ B_s(0) (open ball), and x ∈ closedBall(0, R). Let b(y) := φ(x − y). Then b is smooth (ContDiff ℝ ⊤), b has compact support, tsupport b ⊆ B_{2R}(0), and ∫_{ℝⁿ} φ(x − y) dy = ∫_{ℝⁿ} φ(y) dy.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R s : ℝ) (φ : Euclid n → ℝ) (x : Euclid n), s < R → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → tsupport φ ⊆ ball 0 s → x ∈ closedBall 0 R → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun y => φ (x - y)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun y => φ (x - y)) ∧ tsupport (fun y => φ (x - y)) ⊆ ball 0 (2 * R) ∧ ∫ y, φ (x - y) = ∫ y, φ y
